summary: All 3 blocking findings are valid spec gaps and should be repaired before spec-gate.

items.title: Gate defer references artifacts that do not exist for all tracked gate phases
items.rationale: The current spec requires sourceArtifact/sourceFindingId references but does not define a durable source for draft/spec gate findings. A bounded gate findings source or alternate reference must be specified.
items.evidence: spec-review.json blockingFindings[0]; spec.json requirements R3/R4 and overview.data_flow currently imply all gate phases already have durable artifacts.

items.title: Deferred completion conflicts with existing completion contracts
items.rationale: The spec must define how a retained FAIL/fail detector artifact, flow findings entry, and step completion validation can coexist without rewriting detector artifacts as pass.
items.evidence: spec-review.json blockingFindings[1]; source context references src/flow/lib/flow-judgment-contract.js completion validation.

items.title: Final disposition ownership conflicts between artifacts
items.rationale: The spec currently assigns finalDisposition to flow-findings while also making acceptance-review.json the source of truth. The authority rule must be made unambiguous.
items.evidence: spec-review.json blockingFindings[2]; spec.json constraints and R4/R5.
